minutes.headline: TCP committee approved the schematic design for adjacencies and areas, leaving the Boys and Girls Club out.
minutes.summary: After public comment from the Boys and Girls Club, the Lions Club and a selectman asking for space in TC Passios, the committee said it could not fit them. It then voted by roll call to approve the schematic design plan with department sign-offs, and reviewed a draft Town Meeting presentation. It set meetings for Nov 9 and Nov 30.

what_happened.line: The Building Design Committee voted 5-0 by roll call to approve the schematic plans for departmental adjacencies and areas, meeting rooms and storage locations.
The Boys and Girls Club, the Lions Club and a selectman asked for space in the TC Passios building; the committee said it could not fit them.
Committee organization (chair, vice chair, clerk) was tabled until more members, including a new planning board member, join.
The chair will draft an outline of the Town Meeting presentation, described as an update rather than an approval or funding request.
Next meetings were set for Nov 9 and Nov 30 at 5:30, and the approved plan will go on the town website once packaged.

why_it_matters: The approved schematic layout fixes which departments occupy the building and leaves out the Boys and Girls Club and the Lions Club food pantry, so those services would need space elsewhere.

Costs, including a possible commercial kitchen, are to be reviewed in design development, and those numbers shape what residents are later asked to fund; the Town Meeting article carries no funding request.
watch_next: Committee meetings on Nov 9 and Nov 30 at 5:30.
Handout materials due to the town clerk by Nov 12, and the schematic plan to be posted on the town website.
